I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I couldn't confirm the date.

- **Nothing on record:** there are no account files for Thornbury Cloth Co. and nothing about them in the workspace brain. So there's no order form or signing date to check the 23 May claim against.
- **The date is odd:** today is 14 Oct 2026, so 23 May has already passed. Either they meant May 2027 or the date was misheard.
- **Next steps I suggested:** treat it as hearsay until someone gets it in writing from Thornbury. June Osei-Lark on deal desk may also have the order form.

I didn't save the 23 May date to the brain as a fact, since it's unverified. Her message is still in the brain as part of the channel history.
